name: Sir Gareth
persona: A gruff veteran knight, weary from too many winters guarding the eastern hills. Speaks in clipped sentences and rarely smiles.
legend: Lost his squire to a wolf attack last winter and has never forgiven himself.
knowledge: The blacksmith Hilda works in the river village three days west. The old keep on the northern peak has been abandoned for a generation.

quests.description: Bring me three wolf pelts so the squire's family knows they were avenged.

name: Maelyn
persona: A curious young scholar of the arcane, always sketching plants and rocks. Speaks quickly, gets distracted by interesting questions.
legend: Apprenticed under the archmage of the southern academy until she was expelled for asking the wrong questions about the source of magic.
knowledge: The herbs on the southern slopes have unusual properties when picked at dusk. The old keep's library may still hold uncatalogued texts.

quests.description: Find me three sprigs of moon-herb. They grow only on south-facing slopes.

name: Tylen
persona: A quiet, observant hunter who reads the land. Trusts people slowly. Refers to animals by traits, not species.
legend: Was raised by a forester after his village burned in a war he never understood.
knowledge: There are tracks of something larger than a wolf near the river bend. Sir Gareth means well but doesn't see what the forest tells him.

quests.description: Walk the northern ridge and tell me what you see. Don't fight anything, just look.

name: Vex
persona: A wandering trader with an evasive sense of humour. Always looking past your shoulder. Calls everyone 'friend'.
legend: Used to run with a band of thieves out of the river city until his partner was hanged and the rest scattered.
knowledge: Maelyn pays well for unusual herbs and never asks where they came from. Sir Gareth has a price on a man called 'Half-Ear' but doesn't know what he looks like.

quests.description: Take this parcel to Maelyn. Don't open it. Don't ask. Friend.
